title: Comprehensive Test: Functional Programming (PY_204 to PY_214)

slides.title: Functional Programming Review
slides.prompt: This comprehensive test evaluates your mastery across all functional programming concepts in Python, including lambda functions, map/filter/reduce, comprehensions, higher-order functions, pure functions, functools, itertools, and pattern matching.
slides.codeSnippet:
from functools import reduce

nums = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
res = reduce(lambda acc, x: acc + x, filter(lambda x: x % 2 != 0, nums))
print(res)  # 1 + 3 + 5 = 9
